messages:
release-manager: Heads up — we're holding the canary for release v2026.03.21-rc1 due to an EU inference latency + error spike. Pinning stable (v2026.03.18). Need a quick rollback/swapback plan and a reschedule for the remaining rollout.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary rollout paused for release v2026.03.21-rc1 — reason: region eu latency spike. Actions taken: hold=true, pinned_version=v2026.03.18. To resume: `deploybot resume --release v2026.03.21-rc1`. Audit id: db7f9a.

sre-jen: Looking at the telemetry — kv-cache CPU + context switch rate on eu3 spiked at ~14:12; 95th token-latency ~2x. Errors concentrated on requests routed to gpu-eu3-07. Recommend swapback canary to stable image and cordon that host.

ops-lead: Agree with swapback. Let's avoid a full rollback if it's a single host issue. Plan: swapback canary now, pin the global rollout, drain gpu-eu3-07, reprovision. Reschedule remainder to 02:00 UTC change window. @alice can you start the drain?

alice: On it — cordoning gpu-eu3-07 and starting drain now. Seeing `kernel: Out-of-memory` traces in syslog; looks like driver memory leak. Provision reprovision job queued, estimate 30-40m to replace host.

ben: From product side — if we pin stable, we should update release notes and the status page. I'll draft a short customer note and push to the status page once swapback confirmed. ETA ~15m.

carla: FYI tagging sec/legal not required for this; internal post-mortem should cover root cause.

release-manager: Plan recap: 1) Immediate canary swapback to v2026.03.18 (to limit customer impact), 2) Pin the rollout and hold further slots, 3) Drain/reprovision affected host(s), 4) Update release notes & status page, 5) Reschedule full rollout for 02:00 UTC tomorrow (contingent on infra health). If hosts are healthy earlier we can attempt a limited canary at 22:00 UTC. I'll own comms and open a follow-up postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Action executed: swapped canary -> v2026.03.18 at 14:18 UTC; hold flag set. Audit id: db7f9a. To override or force resume: `deploybot override --audit db7f9a`.
